acceptance_criteria.criterion: On a page with two grids, clicking select all in grid A toggles only grid A's checkboxes
A URL template containing a single quote does not break the page jump JS
PHPStan level 6 reports zero new errors in BaseGridRenderer.php and Bootstrap5Renderer.php

summary: Fixed Bug #1: Select-all JS scoping — changed document.querySelectorAll to this.closest('table').querySelectorAll in createSelectionHeaderCell() so each grid's select-all only affects its own checkboxes.

Fixed Bug #3: XSS in page jump inputs — replaced raw single-quoted JS string interpolation of $urlTemplate with json_encode($urlTemplate) in both BaseGridRenderer::createPageJumpInput() and Bootstrap5Renderer::createBootstrapPageJumpInput().
PHPStan level 6: zero new errors in modified files (14 pre-existing errors in other files).

comments.note: No observations — the touched methods (createSelectionHeaderCell, createPageJumpInput) are clean and consistent with the codebase style.
Dead import: `use AppUtils\Grids\Actions\Type\GridActionInterface;` is present but unused. Not removed in this WP as it belongs to WP-003 scope.

summary: All 3 acceptance criteria verified and passing.
Bug #1 fix: this.closest('table').querySelectorAll() correctly scopes checkbox toggling to the containing grid table — confirmed grid renders inside <table> at BaseGridRenderer line 72.

Bug #3 fix: json_encode($urlTemplate) in both BaseGridRenderer::createPageJumpInput() and Bootstrap5Renderer::createBootstrapPageJumpInput() produces safely escaped JS string literals, preventing XSS from single quotes or other special chars.
PHPStan level 6: zero errors in both modified files; all 14 reported errors are pre-existing in unrelated files (BaseGridColumn, DataGrid, GridForm, RowManager, HeaderRow, MergedRow).
Test suite: no regressions (no tests exist yet, consistent with project status).

comments.note: The $inputId interpolation in JS (document.getElementById('{$inputId}')) still uses direct string embedding without json_encode. Low risk since grid IDs are typically alphanumeric, but worth considering for future hardening.

summary: Code review PASS: Both bug fixes are correctly implemented.
Bug #1: Select-all JS scoping uses this.closest('table').querySelectorAll() — correctly scopes to the containing <table> element.
Bug #3: XSS prevention via json_encode($urlTemplate) in both renderers — eliminates single-quote injection in JS string literals.
PHPStan independently verified: 14 errors all pre-existing. Zero errors in modified files.
Code style consistent with codebase conventions (HTMLTag usage, declare(strict_types=1)).

comments.note: Bug #1: this.closest('table').querySelectorAll() is correct — the grid wraps in <table> (BaseGridRenderer line 72), so closest('table') reliably reaches the right scope.
Bug #3: json_encode($urlTemplate) produces a properly escaped JS string literal with surrounding double quotes, eliminating the XSS vector. Both renderers use identical safe patterns.
QA's note about $inputId direct embedding is valid but low risk — IDs are generated internally as 'grid-{gridId}-page-jump' with alphanumeric gridIds.
